verdict.description: pass only if there are zero blocking findings AND zero weakened gates.

summary.description: Two sentences maximum: what this diff does, and whether it is sound.

blocking.description: Defects that must be fixed before this phase can advance. Empty if none.

line.description: 1-indexed line, or null when the finding is file-level.

why_it_breaks.description: Concrete failure: what input or condition produces what wrong result.

non_blocking.description: Improvements worth making that do not block advancing.

weakened_gates.description: ANY test, gate, tolerance, assertion or check that this diff weakened, deleted, narrowed, skipped or stubbed. A non-empty list halts the run unconditionally. Report suspicion here rather than staying silent.
